reviews.pros: Products are good and selling on its brand name.
reviews.cons:
1) Dealer and retail oriented organization. Their 70% to 75% business revenue comes from trade and B2C segment. 
2) Not much focused on B2B business. 
3) Employee growth and development is very less.
4) Dealers and distributors are more important than the employee. All company benefits and programs are focused on dealers and retailers growth.
5) Department wise internal politics also persist.
6) Very high attrition rate. Every month, 4-5 employees resigns and same no of employees joins the company. 
7) HR is always on their toes for finding new candidates and conducting interviews.
8) Very complex and critical organization structure. For a new joinee,  it takes 6-7 months to understand the people, culture and atmosphere. By that time, people gets changed or person himself resigns.
9) Always there is a fear for job security
